target: HyperEVM non-liquidation maintenance classes beyond the closed keeper scout (lead 127): liquid-staking / yield-aggregator / curator pokes (kinetiq-*, sthype, hyperbeat-*, hyperlend-pooled, felix-vaults, felix-cdp, veda, upshift, d2-finance, growihf) as anyone-callable functions that pay their caller on a chain nobody keeps yet
why: HyperEVM (the farm chain added 2026-11-10) has no farm bot and no non-liquidation class measured profitable yet: the first keeper/poke scout closed saturated (lead 127, attempts 836 and 840 - incumbent income 0.26 native/day vs 0.247 native/day gas on a 10-second cadence), and the liquidation books (moonwell, morpho, compound, gearbox, venus, revert lend, hyperlend) are closed for new scouting per decisions/human/2026-11-08-beyond-liquidations.md. DefiLlama lists 217 protocols on Hyperliquid L1, 151 of them outside the CEX/bridge/staking categories, so the class space is large; this row only points at where the contract addresses are already cached, it is not a measurement.
next_steps: (1) The Hyperliquid-L1 adapter files for the 45 largest non-CEX protocols are already cached on this host from 2026-11-10T20:0Z run a142a254: scratch/llama-adapters/<slug>.js (58 files; fetch the rest from https://api.llama.fi/adapter/llamas/<slug>.js, and the slug list is in scratch/hype-slugs.txt / scratch/hype-slugs2.txt) - grep them for the protocol's HyperEVM contract addresses instead of hunting for an explorer (no free HyperEVM explorer API works here, wiki infra/hyperevm-scout-tooling.md). (2) For each candidate, pin one anyone-callable maintenance function (rebalance/distribute/checkpoint/claim style) with its payment leg measured through the relay: a prestateTracer diffMode trace returns NO diff on hyperevm, so read the caller's balance at two explicit block numbers and subtract gas (0.2 gwei observed, 191168 gas = 3.82e-5 native ~ 0.0013 USD at 35 USD/HYPE), or use the fork at `fork url hyperevm` (port 9008; keep every transaction under 2,000,000 gas). (3) Name the incumbent that calls it today the way lead 127 was named: sample recent blocks with eth_getBlockByNumber(full) and count repeated senders (HyperEVM blocks are 2 s: 40 blocks is a window, 10000 blocks is 5.5 h; use head-10 as the toBlock bound). (4) Only then decide EV after gas and the race question (a >1-minute window per attempts 840's method). A first promote here also needs the human to deposit native HYPE (plus USDC if principal_usdc) into the hyperevm intermediate wallet: gate status shows it.
